import os,re,json,glob
from collections import Counter

def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi=G['Demo pair 1 input']; go=G['Demo pair 1 output']
g2=G['Demo pair 2 input']; o2=G['Demo pair 2 output']

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==g[r][0] and x!=bg for x in g[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==g[0][c] and g[r][c]!=bg for r in range(H))]
    def bands(nm,D):
        d=sorted(D)+([nm] if nm not in D else []); b=[]; prev=-1
        for i in d+[nm]:
            if i>prev+1: b.append((prev+1,i-1)); prev=i
        return b
    rb=bands(H,rows); cb=bands(W,cols)
    # connected components of non-bg cells
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    used=set(); comps=[]
    for p in cells:
        if p in used: continue
        st=[p]; used.add(p); comp=[]
        while st:
            y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if q in cells and q not in used:
                    used.add(q); st.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    yxs=max(comps,key=len)
    rmin=min(r for r,_ in yxs); rmax=max(r for r,_ in yxs)
    cmin=min(c for _,c in yxs); cmax=max(c for _,c in yxs)
    src=[[g[r][c] for c in range(cmin,cmax+1)] for r in range(rmin,rmax+1)]
    sh,sq=len(src),len(src[0])
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        if r in rows: continue
        bi=sum(1 for d in rows if d<r)
        r0,r1=rb[bi]
        for c in range(W):
            if c in cols: continue
            bc=sum(1 for d in cols if d<c)
            c0,c1=cb[bc]
            rr=r-r0; cc=c-c0
            if 0<=rr<len(src) and 0<=cc<len(src[0]):
                out[r][c]=src[rr][cc]
    for r in rows:
        for c in range(W): out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    for c in cols:
        for r in range(H): out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    return out
